title: Pregnant Blend 4-Mix Solo #19 (부채꼴·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her late 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, smooth healthy skin, defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips, a poised, mature, confident expression, bright golden-blonde hair styled in sleek straight, real pores, real living eyes, 25 clicker rings piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in bronze-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum a hair ornament. Full body painted in 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 50% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 9 o'clock, 12 o'clock, 2 o'clock and 6 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with organic curved mosaic filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 2 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with lattice linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 2 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs), wide cream bands following the contours of the body, with concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands. Region 4 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with folk-art florals filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
